summary.text: Karen Brownlee is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 28 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A social worker, she serves on the Children and Human Services, Community Revitalization and House Health committees.

paragraphs.text: Karen Brownlee graduated from the University of Michigan and Northern Kentucky University, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a social worker.
She assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, and faces Jill Cole (R) in the general election.
